personality_one_liner: A highly readable, efficient, and tactile interface that gets out of the way, prioritizing speed for front-of-house and clarity for the kitchen.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around content. Clear grouping of related elements. Avoid dense dashboard-style layouts unless the app is data-heavy.

screens.name: Role Selection
screens.purpose: Allow user to select whether they are a Master (Waiter) or Chef.
screens.layout: Vertical stack centered. Large touch targets (cards) for Master and Chef. Use hero images/icons in the cards. Safe area aware.

screens.name: Master Dashboard (Tabs: Menu, Orders)
screens.purpose: Primary hub for Waiter to browse menu, add items to cart, and view order history.

states.empty: Illustration of empty table with text 'No items available' and CTA to add items.
states.error: Failed to load menu, retry button

screens.layout: Top custom header. Categorized horizontal chips for filtering. Grid of menu items (2 columns) with image, title, price, and Zomato/Swiggy style stepper (Add / - 1 +). Sticky bottom cart summary (glassmorphism) over scrolling list, revealing total price and 'Place Order' CTA.

screens.name: Cart & Checkout Sheet
screens.purpose: Review items, quantities, and place the final order to the kitchen.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet. List of selected items with steppers. Swipe to delete. Total calculation at bottom. Large sticky primary CTA 'Send to Kitchen'.

screens.name: Chef Kitchen Display (Tabs: Pending, Completed)
screens.purpose: Kitchen Display System (KDS) for chefs to see active orders and mark them as complete.

states.empty: Illustration of clean kitchen, 'No pending orders, take a break!'
states.error: Failed to sync orders, retry button

screens.layout: Focus on high visibility. Split view or large vertical list of 'Tickets'. Each ticket is a surfaceSecondary card with order #, time elapsed (color coded for urgency), list of items with modifiers bolded. Entire ticket or large primary button to mark 'Complete'. Large text for readability at arm's length.

screens.name: Menu Management (Master)
screens.purpose: Master can add new items to the menu with photo, name, and price.
screens.layout: Simple form. Image picker at top (rounded square), floating label text inputs for Name, Category, Price. Sticky bottom CTA 'Save Item'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. Do not use blue or indigo anywhere.
Implement the Zomato/Swiggy style stepper component for menu items (Add button transforms into - 1 + on tap).
For the KDS (Chef View), ensure font sizes for items are large (xl or 2xl) and touch targets (complete button) are massive, as chefs use this with messy hands from a distance.
Implement a sticky cart summary at the bottom of the Master menu screen when items are in the cart. Use glassmorphism for this sticky container.
Ensure the Chef view uses real-time or auto-refresh polling (setInterval) to fetch new orders continuously.
Use Phosphor icons consistently, outlined only.
